header.name: STANDING_FORMS
header.cut: A stored desc is <base> or <base> <standing>; the standing is always the TAIL (R5D-0 Q3), written by annotateFactionStanding as one or more forms joined by one space (a rank line, then rivalry notes). THE CUT: find, over every row, the match of "(?:^| )(" + re + ")" in the remaining text (re ends in $, so a match is a tail; its span is fixed by its EARLIEST start and the $ anchor, so the two engines' alternation preferences cannot move it); remove the LONGEST (earliest-starting; a tie by the smaller id) with its joining space; repeat while a row matches. No row matches: the desc is served as it is (a base, E121 (b)). Patterns: Postgres ARE and JavaScript RegExp alike, case-sensitive, no flags, no \b, no named groups, no backslash at all (a metacharacter is a one-character bracket, [.]), only (?:...), [...], bounded {m,n}; the name slot is bounded by powerSentenceName (words of letters, apostrophes and hyphens, at most six, no sentence end), never .* or .+.

slots.name: powerSentenceName(<a power>) (data/people/powerSentenceName.js), the tip's; in a choice with the engine's literals
slots.label: a raw roster label (master and older engines printed f.faction): NAME words, one slashed pair, one trailing bracket
slots.mask: E136 (a): a name or label slot also takes the projection's mask, the one literal "an unseen interest" (publicSafe.js :: HIDDEN_POWER_MASK, which maskText writes over a hidden power's label), in its own lower case wherever the slot stands
slots.force: force.body (defense/defenseFacts.js :: forceWordsOf); older engines wrote the literal garrison (a closed form)
slots.choice: a conditional between single phrases inside one sentence ({have|has}, {council vote|decision}, {NAME|the second power})

header.grows: Rows only GROW: a stored document keeps the form its engine wrote. A changed form ships WITH a migration adding it to 212.
